### Packages

```{r}
# Packages (only base + tidyverse)
library(tidyverse)

```

### Import Data

```{r}

# Where you want the matrices to live (change this!)
data_dir <- "~/github/oyster-lnc/data/15-pearsons"

# URLs or paths to your matrices (replace with your real links)
lnc_url  <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zbengt/oyster-lnc/refs/heads/main/output/10-count-matrices-DESeq2-final/kallisto-count-matrix/Cvirg_lncRNA_count_matrix.isoform.counts.matrix"
mrna_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sr320/ceabigr/refs/heads/main/output/34-transcript-counts/transcript_counts_per_gene_per_sample.csv"

# Filenames to save as inside dest_dir
lnc_file  <- file.path(data_dir, "lnc_counts.tsv")
mrna_file <- file.path(data_dir, "mrna_counts.tsv")

if (!file.exists(lnc_file)) {
  message("Downloading lncRNA matrix to: ", lnc_file)
  download.file(lnc_url, destfile = lnc_file, mode = "wb")
} else {
  message("Using existing lncRNA matrix at: ", lnc_file)
}

if (!file.exists(mrna_file)) {
  message("Downloading mRNA matrix to: ", mrna_file)
  download.file(mrna_url, destfile = mrna_file, mode = "wb")
} else {
  message("Using existing mRNA matrix at: ", mrna_file)
}

lnc_raw <- readr::read_tsv(lnc_file)
mrna_raw <- readr::read_tsv(mrna_file)

### load matrices

## lncRNA
lnc_raw <- readr::read_tsv(lnc_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# First column is called `...1` -> rename to gene_id
lnc_raw <- lnc_raw %>%
  rename(gene_id = `...1`)

lnc_mat <- lnc_raw %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

## mRNA

# This file is comma-separated
mrna_raw <- readr::read_csv(mrna_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# First column should be gene_name; the rest include transcript_counts.* and summary columns
# 1) rename gene_name -> gene_id
# 2) keep only the transcript count columns
mrna_counts <- mrna_raw %>%
  rename(gene_id = gene_name) %>%
  select(gene_id, starts_with("transcript_counts."))

# 3) strip the "transcript_counts." prefix so sample names match lnc_mat (S12M, S13M, ...)
colnames(mrna_counts)[-1] <- sub("^transcript_counts\\.", "", colnames(mrna_counts)[-1])

mrna_mat <- mrna_counts %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

```
```{r}
# sanity check

head(colnames(lnc_mat))
head(colnames(mrna_mat))
```


### Align Samples Across Matrices

```{r}
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(lnc_mat), colnames(mrna_mat))

lnc_mat <- lnc_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
mrna_mat <- mrna_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]

n_samples <- length(common_samples)  # should be 26
print(n_samples)
```

### Filter out low expression transcripts

```{r}
# standard filtering at this stage
min_count   <- 10
min_samples <- 2

filter_rows <- function(mat, min_count, min_samples) {
  keep <- rowSums(mat >= min_count) >= min_samples
  mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

lnc_mat_f <- filter_rows(lnc_mat,  min_count, min_samples)
mrna_mat_f <- filter_rows(mrna_mat, min_count, min_samples)

```

### Log Scale Counts Transformation

```{r}
lnc_log  <- log2(lnc_mat_f + 1)
mrna_log <- log2(mrna_mat_f + 1)

```

### Pearson correlation matrix

```{r}
# rows = lncRNAs, cols = mRNAs
cor_mat <- cor(t(lnc_log),
               t(mrna_log),
               method = "pearson",
               use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

```

### Comput p-values and FDRs for all pairs

```{r}
# element-wise
# Handle edge case |r| == 1 to avoid division by zero
r_vals <- cor_mat

# Clip slightly if needed
r_vals[r_vals >  0.999999] <-  0.999999
r_vals[r_vals < -0.999999] <- -0.999999

t_vals <- r_vals * sqrt((n_samples - 2) / (1 - r_vals^2))
p_vals <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_vals), df = n_samples - 2)

#Now flatten matrices into a long table and do BH FDR correction
lnc_ids  <- rownames(cor_mat)
mrna_ids <- colnames(cor_mat)

coexp_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(lnc_id = Var1,
         mrna_id = Var2,
         r      = Freq)

# match p-values into the same long format
p_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(p_vals)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(lnc_id = Var1,
         mrna_id = Var2,
         p_value = Freq)

coexp_df <- coexp_df %>%
  left_join(p_df, by = c("lnc_id", "mrna_id"))

# Global FDR across all pairs
coexp_df <- coexp_df %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))


```

### Find significant pairs
```{r}
#Using common thresholds of significance
## |r| ≥ 0.8
## FDR < 0.05

r_threshold   <- 0.8
fdr_threshold <- 0.05

sig_pairs <- coexp_df %>%
  filter(abs(r) >= r_threshold,
         FDR <= fdr_threshold) %>%
  arrange(FDR, desc(abs(r)))

# Inspect top hits
print(sig_pairs %>% head())

```

### Export file for visualization in cytoscape

```{r}
readr::write_tsv(sig_pairs,
                 "~/github/oyster-lnc/output/15-pearsons/lnc_mrna_coexpression_edges.tsv")

```
